basic_info.description: Posh Pacific Heights condo featuring 1 Large Bedroom + Office/Guest Room w/Golden Gate Bridge Views + 1 bath + Abundant Closets + Parking + Roof Area w/Pano GG Bridge Views + Professional Onsite-Manager in elegant Mediterranean-inspired building is now available! Highly desirable floorplan on 4th floor w/western exposure enjoys natural sunlight & twilight, tastefully blending old-world charm w/modern updates. This exquisite condo features: gracious formal entry; large, formal living room w/views of Golden Gate Bridge, Mt. Tamalpais & SF Bay, elegant bay windows & warm afternoon sunlight; intimate dining area perfect for formal dining or casual entertaining w/built-in cabinets to store linen/dishware; updated kitchen w/stainless steel appliances, abundant storage & views of GG Bridge; large bedroom accommodates king-size bed w/nightstands & dressers + features bay windows, views of GG Bridge, 2 large, walk-in closets with built-ins; bonus office/guest room with classic French Doors opening to west to enjoy natural sunlight; classic Art Deco-inspired bathroom w/separate shower stall & tub! Tasteful 1930s craftsmanship w/wood floors & molding. Bldg: 2 elevators, roof w/360-degree views of GG Bridge, Mt. Tam, Salesforce! HOA Dues incl: Water, Heat, Trash + Professional Onsite Manager
